description: Archive a thread (remove it from the inbox). USE WHEN: inbox triage — the thread is handled and should leave the inbox. DO NOT USE: to delete (use trash) or to defer to a date (use snooze). Pass `threadIds` (a list of up to 100) instead of `threadId` to apply the same change to every listed thread in one call — for 'exactly these threads, as approved'. The answer then reports per thread: `changed`, `failed` (with code and message; the others still ran) and `notAttempted` (the run stopped at a rate limit, dead token or missing scope, which would have hit every remaining thread alike); `ok` is true only when all were changed. SIDE EFFECTS: thread leaves the inbox; reversible via modify_labels add INBOX.
name: archive
